integrity: The proof classifies the paths of the level-preserving missing-comparability graph. Finite checks supplement the exact interval argument.
scientific_limitations: The distinct claim is the finite automorphism profile for these explicit posets, not the separately covered rigidity of the infinite witnesses. This does not classify endomorphisms or p-morphisms or address all strictly n-finite varieties.
title: Exact automorphism groups of the finite level truncations of the canonical Esakia spaces
